limitations: Onlytwo small environments; breast-cancer replication is conditional on one corpus.
Twelve independent seed units and approximate t intervals may be sensitive to nonnormality; no exact finite-sample family inference claimed.
Positive max-scan score contrast can concern early behavior, full-curve range normalization, changing partitions and training paths; it does not establish a late event without the separate gate.
Separate family4 scan, family4 boundary and family12 gate intervals do not jointly provide95%coverage across all quantities.
R12 fixed512 boundary/64-point gate may miss acceleration elsewhere or on another timescale.
Default CI must not train models; only the explicit registered research smoke may fit a toy model.
